direction: Continuous custom R with connected terminal cursor
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Design one genuinely distinctive minimalist Retty terminal app symbol. Retty means reconnect TTY / relay TTY: one persistent terminal session continues between Mac, iPhone and headless servers. The visual identity should express an R and a continuing terminal cursor in ONE coherent custom glyph.
Canvas: one square image, approximately 1536 × 1536. A single upright rounded-square tile with continuous smooth native-app corners, centered with 8% breathing space on all sides. The tile is very dark blue-green #102B2D, almost flat and matte. The area outside the tile is genuinely transparent. No surrounding scene, screenshot, desk or mockup.
Primary symbol: create ONE large friendly custom R-shaped ribbon glyph in warm soft apricot #FFC48C, optically centered in the tile. This is not a typeset letter. The form is built from one bold, smooth stroke of uniform substantial thickness, with softly rounded ends and gentle joins. Its left stem stands upright; its upper half turns into one generous open rounded rectangular loop, bends back toward the middle of the stem, and then flows diagonally down to the right. The diagonal lower leg curves gently into a SHORT HORIZONTAL right-facing terminal cursor at its bottom. This cursor is physically connected to the R leg, not an extra underscore. The whole continuous glyph should feel like a small forward-moving ribbon and a reconnecting terminal line. The R remains immediately recognizable. Preserve one generous clean counter-space in the upper loop, and one broad open space between the lower legs. Use compact friendly proportions, a relatively large soft upper loop, and a short lower body. The glyph occupies about 52% of tile width and 60% of tile height, with generous negative space.
The silhouette should be simple enough to recognize at 24–32 pixels. Keep the continuous upper loop open enough to read clearly. No redundant flourish, small notch, detached component or thin gap.
Style: ultra-clean geometric graphic mark, calm and charming through soft chunky geometry, almost flat color. Tiny restrained tonal variation within the dark tile is acceptable, but the symbol is a solid apricot silhouette. No gradients on the glyph, no highlights, no bevel or glossy 3D.
Constraints: Do not use a standalone > chevron plus separate underscore. Do not copy the conventional green >_ terminal icon. No mint-green glyph, no face, eyes, smiles, mascot, chains, infinity sign, multiple arrows, screens, devices, stars, circles or extra decorations. No text, labels, full word Retty, watermark, borders, external cast shadow or perspective. Only the one dark teal rounded-square tile and the one apricot R-and-connected-cursor glyph.
